scope.decodedState: complete effective classic-rumble motor snapshot only

decoderPolicy.envelope: Accept only HidOutput(0), ReportId 0x02, and exactly 47 Data bytes.
decoderPolicy.legacyUpdate: Apply both motor bytes atomically only when haptics-select and the legacy compatible-vibration bit are set, and the v2 bit is clear.
decoderPolicy.v2Update: Apply both motor bytes atomically only when haptics-select and the v2 compatible-vibration bit are set, and the legacy bit is clear.
decoderPolicy.validZeroUpdate: A source-proven update combination with two zero motor bytes is an explicit stop.
decoderPolicy.allZeroUpdate: An exactly all-zero 47-byte payload is the SDL restore-audio-haptics/stop idiom and clears both effective motors.
decoderPolicy.partialValidity: Selector-only, motor-validity-without-selector, and conflicting legacy-plus-v2 combinations preserve the prior motor state and are surfaced distinctly.
decoderPolicy.unrelatedFields: A structurally valid packet with no motor validity and nonzero unrelated fields preserves the prior motor state.
decoderPolicy.snapshot: Every structurally accepted packet returns an owned, complete effective two-motor snapshot; preserve never becomes implicit zero, and zero never gets filtered.
decoderPolicy.bufferLifetime: Decode synchronously in the OutputReceived callback or copy Data first; never retain HMOutputPacket.Data across callbacks.

unsupportedAssumptions: No claim is made about malformed or partial flag combinations on physical DualSense firmware; the contract deliberately preserves state for those combinations.
No claim is made that the unsigned source tree matches a particular installed signed HIDMaestro driver package.
No SDK, driver, controller, process, shared section, event, or device was loaded or exercised by this contract.
Adaptive triggers, lightbar, audio controls, audio haptics, feature reports, Bluetooth framing, and CRC are outside this one-profile adapter.
The contract cannot repair packets already overwritten in HIDMaestro's 64-slot output ring; the host must monitor HMOutputPacket.SeqNo for gaps.
Hardware conformance and captured Windows game traffic remain required before product enablement.
